signs.name: Dip
signs.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers to a dip in the road surface ahead. A dip can reduce vehicle control and visibility, so drivers should slow down, maintain steering control, and be prepared for suspension movement. This sign warns drivers of a sharp right turn ahead. Drivers should reduce speed, stay within their lane, and prepare to steer carefully to avoid losing control while navigating the tight curve safely. The sign indicates a sharp left turn ahead. Drivers should slow down in advance, keep proper lane position, and be ready to steer smoothly to safely negotiate the turn without sudden braking.

signs.name: Traffic Lights & Road Lines - Signals & Markings
signs.explanation: Green streamers on traffic lights advise drivers to prepare to pass. It indicates permission to proceed while remaining alert to conditions ahead. This green light indicates drivers may proceed but should remain cautious, especially at intersections, watching for pedestrians or turning vehicles. A red light means drivers must wait and stop completely before the stop line or intersection until the signal changes.
